## Reshelving order

Books on the sorting cart are carried to the stacks in Dewey decimal order
by call number. Oversize volumes sit on the bottom shelf of each
range, and reference works never leave the reading room.

## Cart sweeps

Staff empty the cart at opening, midday and closing. Anything left on it
overnight is logged in the morning.
